cut: RFH global, VIRAL CUT v1 (24 Oct): towns sign secrecy deals (NDAs) about data centres in their own town. Hook first (the sealed NDA envelope on the town hall steps); the blank data centre rises behind the houses; Virginia, 25 of 31 places checked; the developers' stated reason, insider trading rules; Delaware banned them in August, the envelope tears: loop. | v2 (24 Oct, owner): a proper US flag; the ending says what the deals do (kept from the people next door) and what Delaware did; a 3.6 s hold on the punchline before the loop eases home.
argument: Towns sign secrecy deals with data-centre developers about buildings in their own town; Virginia records requests found them in 25 of 31 places, developers cite insider trading rules, and Delaware banned them in August 2026.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Your town signed / a secrecy deal / on a [data centre].
text.ja: あなたの町が データセンターの / [秘密保持契約] に 署名。

captions.source: Framing of the record below: local governments in several US states have signed NDAs with data-centre developers (Virginia Mercury 25 Oct 2024; Bloomberg Government 2026; Wisconsin Watch Jan 2026; Spotlight PA Aug 2026; NPR 26 Aug 2026). 'Your town' is the address to the viewer, not a claim about any one town.

text.en: Kept secret from / the people who / [live next to it].
text.ja: すぐ隣に 住む / 人々には / [秘密]。

captions.source: What an NDA does here: it binds the officials not to disclose the project, so residents next to the site are not told while it is negotiated (Virginia Mercury 25 Oct 2024; Bloomberg Law; Spotlight PA; NPR, Louisiana, 26 Aug 2026). v2 (owner, 24 Oct): replaces 'About a building in your town' so the film says what the deal does.

text.en: Virginia: secrecy / deals in [25 of 31] / places checked.
text.ja: バージニア州： 調べた / 31か所中 [25か所] で / 秘密保持契約。

captions.source: Eric Bonds (University of Mary Washington) and students sent public records requests in 2025 to every Virginia locality with a proposed or existing data-centre project; reported results: 25 of 31 had NDAs. Outlets word the unit as localities (Yahoo/Newsweek) or as proposed projects (Bloomberg Government), hence 'places checked'. Search summaries only; the study itself not opened.

text.ja: 開発業者の 理由： / [インサイダー取引] 規制。

captions.source: Tom's Hardware: a developer argues the NDAs are important to avoid running afoul of insider-trading rules ('Many talks between data center developers and local governments are under NDA…'). Attributed as the developers' stated reason, as reported; a tag says AS REPORTED. Search summary only.

text.en: One US state, / Delaware, now / [bans] them.
text.ja: 米国の 1州、 / デラウェアは 今、 / それを [禁止]。

captions.source: Delaware state law (Del. Code title 9, ch. 4, as found by search; the enacted text could not be opened from this session): a county may not enter an NDA that restricts public disclosure about large-scale data-centre development (100 MW or more); such NDAs are void. Passed by the legislature (June 2026; MLex, 21 Aug, says it cleared the legislature). The signing date and any wider scope (state agencies, municipalities) are NOT confirmed, so the film says only county deals, and no date. v2 (owner, 24 Oct: the ending needs clarity): the line now says what the deals do (they keep the project from the residents next to it: the NDAs bind officials not to disclose, Virginia Mercury, Bloomberg Law, Spotlight PA) and what Delaware did. 'Them' is scoped on screen by the tag DELAWARE LAW · COUNTY NDAs · DATA CENTRES 100 MW+ and the clipping DELAWARE LAW · COUNTY DEALS. v3 (owner, 24 Oct: 'end is unclear'): 'void' was jargon. 'Bans' rests on the Delaware Code text as found by search (title 9, ch. 4): it makes it UNLAWFUL for a county to enter an NDA restricting public disclosure on a data-centre development of 100 MW or more, and such NDAs are void. That covers counties only, so the tag carries the scope (COUNTY NDAs · DATA CENTRES 100 MW+). Search summary only; the enacted text not opened.

post.en: Towns sign secrecy deals about data centres in their own town, so the people next door aren't told. Virginia records requests found them in 25 of 31 places checked. Developers cite insider trading rules. Delaware now bans them for counties (100 MW+). Did your town sign one?
post.fi: Kunnat allekirjoittavat salassapitosopimuksia datakeskushankkeista, eikä naapureille kerrota. Virginiassa sopimus löytyi 25 paikasta 31:stä. Rakennuttajat vetoavat sisäpiirisääntöihin. Delaware kieltää nyt piirikuntien sopimukset yli 100 MW:n hankkeissa. Allekirjoittiko kuntasi?
post.ja: データセンターについて秘密保持契約を結び、隣に住む人々に知らせない町がある。バージニア州では調べた31か所中25か所で見つかった。開発業者の理由はインサイダー取引規制。デラウェア州は100MW以上の案件で郡の契約を禁止した。あなたの町は？
